definitions.short: to tap , i.e. beat regularly ; hence (generally) to impel or agitate
definitions.full: H6470. paam [ מָּעַם ] verb thrust, impel (probably originally strike, hit , see derivatives, and Phoenician פעם foot ); — Qal Infinitive construct suffix לְפַעֲמוֺ Judg 13:25 the spirit of ׳י began to impel him. Niph`al be distrurbed, Perfect 1singular נִפְעַמְתִּי Psa 77:5 ; Imperfect 3feminine singular רוּחוֺ וַתִּמָּ֫עֶם Gen 41:8 ; Dan 2:3 ; so Hithpa`el Imperfect 3feminine singular רוּחוֺ וַתִּתְמָּ֫עֶם Dan 2:1 .

occurrences.englishText: In the morning, his spirit was troubled, and he sent and called for all of Egypt’s magicians and wise men. Pharaoh told them his dreams, but there was no one who could interpret them to Pharaoh.
Yahweh’s Spirit began to move him in Mahaneh Dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.
I have considered the days of old,
In the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams; and his spirit was troubled, and his sleep went from him.
The king said to them, “I have dreamed a dream, and my spirit is troubled to know the dream.”
